data.text: [00:00]CD1 Track 31
A = Assistant, P = Passenger
[00:08]Can I help you?
[00:09.7]I’d like a return to Edinburgh, please.
[00:12]Yes … when would you like to travel?
[00:14.5]On Friday afternoon ... and coming back on Sunday evening.
[00:19]OK … uh … there’s a train at five forty-five p.m. on Friday.
[00:26]Yes, that’s fine. Oh, and can you tell me how long the train takes?
[00:31]Erm ... yes. It takes about five hours.
[00:35.7]Thank you.
P1 = Passenger1, P2 = Passenger 2
[00:44.9]Err... do you know if this is the train to Cardiff please?
[00:49]Yes, it is.
[00:50]Oh good. Is this seat free? ... I mean, is it OK with you if I sit here?
[00:58]Yes, of course. No problem.
[01:03]Excuse me, is this your newspaper? Do you mind if I read it?
[01:09.5]No, that’s fine. Go ahead.
A = Assistant, C = Customer
[01:21]Hello. How are you?
[01:22.7]I’m good thanks. How are you?
[01:25.3]Good thanks. Do you need any help?
[01:27.7]Oh, yes, please. Can you tell me if you have this jacket in medium?
[01:32.5]Yes, certainly, I’ll just have a look for you. … Here you are.
[01:38]Thanks. Oh, and could you tell me how much it is please?
[01:42]Yes, of course. It’s fifty-five dollars.
[01:45.2]OK, I’ll take it. Is it OK if I pay by credit card?
[01:49.3]Yes, that’s fine.
